shared_elements: low-relief carved symbolic signs on a flat-ish surface
justification: Both surfaces carry relief-carved symbolic signs arranged in rough horizontal bands and include human forms and a disc-like circular element, but these are generic correspondences. A is a monumental three-dimensional figure with a headdress and a few large bold emblems (concentric circle, bands) distributed over a body, whereas B is a flat panel filled with many rows of small repeated script-like signs plus small kneeling figures at the base flanking the lower register — a wholly different organisation and scale of motif.
